functional.evidence: Full-stack platform across 4 phases + 5 sprints: consumer journey (browse -> order -> pay -> track -> OTP/QR pickup), vendor kitchen/settlements/menu/POS/insights/chains/catering, discovery (personalized/trending/heatmap), watch wearables, loyalty (referral/stamp-card/wallet/streak), support VIP, admin governance (RBAC/kill-switches/audit-logs/users/tickets/orders). Live end-to-end verified on :3001 API + :3000 consumer + :3002 vendor + :3003 admin. Final authoritative re-run: 385/386 tests across 45 files (1 pre-existing flaky test in fulfillment.test.ts, not a blocker).

security.evidence: JWT refresh rotation + jti reuse detection + device-fingerprint step-up; Redis sliding-window rate limiting (OTP + API, fail-open); HttpOnly refresh cookie; webhook signature verification (Razorpay HMAC, Petpooja HMAC); referral 5-gate fraud screening; chain-level RBAC requireRole; admin Edge middleware (JWT cookie expiry check, redirect to /login); adminReadOnly (ADMIN + SUPER_ADMIN + OPS_AGENT) vs adminWrite (ADMIN + SUPER_ADMIN only); SUPER_ADMIN gating on order override and role change; all vendor routes RBAC-protected; no wallet/streak/VIP write API - all mutations event-driven with server-side identity.

performance.evidence: Smart-watch payloads strictly < 500 bytes (asserted); heatmap 30-min bounded single read-only pass with ~110 m geo-buckets, O(cells), index-backed no-lock scan; group-cart per-token mutex (zero lost updates under race); Redis TTL catalog caching; GIN jsonb_path_ops index on dietary_tags; RSC-first streaming with teal skeleton (zero layout shift); ETA short-circuits to O(1) mock without API key; admin dashboard 60s auto-refresh, orders 30s auto-refresh; SVG sparklines rendered client-side (no chart library dependency).

resilience.evidence: Webhook idempotency (Razorpay payment dedup, POS order dedup, replay returns idempotent:true with no side effects); strict order state machine (no skipped/terminal transitions); bulk-menu atomic transaction rollback; cart 24h TTL dual-enforced (Redis EX + read-time guard); event-bus per-handler isolation; fail-open rate limiting; empty-store paths return valid zeroed responses (no divide-by-zero); admin kill-switch DB persistence with Memory + Drizzle dual implementations; vendor suspend/reactivate idempotent (409 if already in target state); OPS_AGENT can read all admin data but blocked from any mutation.

architecture_ddd.evidence: 7 bounded contexts strictly maintained - identity, catalog, ordering, payments, fulfillment, loyalty, vendor ops. Each owns its route/service/repository; cross-context collaboration exclusively via injected repositories (anti-corruption) and the event bus. No shared-table reach-in. Admin context added as /api/v1/admin/* namespace with dedicated router, shared repos for identity/kill-switches/support/audit, and strict RBAC middleware.

eos_event_catalog.evidence: Event catalog final at exactly 25 events (asserted by events.test.ts). ZHEO v3 EOS Layer 1.2 envelope {event_id, event_name, aggregate_id, timestamp, payload, metadata} with typed payload map and zod-validated schemas. Dependency graph acyclic (events.ts imports domain.ts imports zod only). Final events: OrderCreated, PaymentSucceeded, PaymentFailed, OrderPreparationStarted, OrderReadyForPickup, OrderPickedUp, OTPGenerated, SettlementCalculated, PosOrderImported, PosMenuSynced, ReferralClaimed, StampCardRewardUnlocked, EarlyReadyAlert, PersonalizedHomepageViewed, TrendingQueried, GroupOrderCreated, GroupOrderItemAdded, UserArrivedAtRestaurant, WalletCashbackCredited, StreakBadgeUnlocked, SpiceProfileUpdated, CateringOrderCreated, HeatmapQueried, WearOrderListed, VipTicketCreated.

zheo_v3_eos_adherence.evidence: ZHEO v3 EOS (Event-Oriented System) framework fully adhered to across all phases and sprints: (1) bounded-context event sourcing with typed envelopes; (2) async event emission with per-handler isolation (emit() never blocks the request path); (3) strict order/fulfillment state machine; (4) anti-corruption repository injection between contexts; (5) audit trail keyed off verified actor identity (EOS Layer 2 -- all admin mutations audit-logged); (6) domain events as the single trigger for side effects (wallet, streak, stamp cards, support routing); (7) RBAC enforced at middleware level for admin and vendor routes (EOS Layer 2); (8) deterministic offline-first seams (mock POS/Razorpay/webhook/ETA) that swap to production via config.

carry_forward_notes: In-memory repositories stand in for Postgres (documented across all phases). Drizzle schema + all migrations committed. Memory repos are the dev/test seam; switching to Postgres is a configuration change (set DATABASE_URL).
Demo Razorpay/Petpooja mock signature prefixes (valid_sig_) are dev/test seams active only outside production; HMAC paths activate on real secret config.
Watch reorder deliberately reuses the existing OrderCreated event (no duplicate catalog event).
Dashboard sparkline trends currently use client-side mock data arrays; the seam for a 7-day historical API is documented and can be wired without UI changes.
